name: scenario_0739
description: Connor is analyzing various real estate and property market charts to identify the best performing sectors and regions for investment. He wants to save the top performers in a note and share a specific insight with his friend John.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_3, image_4]
Query: Look at these three charts. I want to keep track of the highest performing markets. Create a note called 'Market Winners' and add the city with the highest median price from the first chart, and the home type that had the smaller drop in 2022 from the third chart. Also, send a text to John comparing the middle chart's data, telling him to invest in the National market because it outperformed Seattle at 10.4%.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a note called 'Market Winners' using data from the first and third images: specifically the city with the highest median price and the home type with the smaller drop in 2022. Also, ask it to text John to invest in the National market because the second image shows it outperformed Seattle at 10.4%. If the assistant flags that the second image actually shows Seattle at 10.4% and National at 5.6% (contradicting your instruction), agree with its observation and say you'll provide updated instructions in a moment. If the assistant doesn't catch the mistake and proceeds to draft or send the wrong message, let it happen and proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2, image_5]
Query: Ah, you're right, I completely misread that middle chart earlier. Seattle actually outperformed at 10.4%. Send the text recommending Seattle instead. Also, look at these two new charts. Update the 'Market Winners' note to include the property type that stayed above its 2007 peak from the first new chart, and the region with the smallest drop from peak to December 2023 in the second new chart.
Instructions: Acknowledge the correction regarding the Seattle chart (or point out the error yourself if the assistant missed it in the previous round) and instruct the assistant to text John recommending Seattle instead. Then, ask it to evaluate the two newly provided images and update the 'Market Winners' note with the property type that stayed above its 2007 peak and the region with the smallest drop from peak to Dec 2023. Once the assistant confirms the text is sent and the note is fully updated, end the conversation.

You have 5 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1

  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
